objective.text: Recognize reference-sharing behavior in an unserialized array cache when testing mutable objects.

difficulty.rationale: Explain a test-only mutation that may not model serialized production cache storage.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The array cache store uses serialize=false.

stem: Why can this test read 2 without a second cache write?

options.text: Every cache driver rereads the original PHP variable on each get.
options.rationale: External stores cannot hold a live reference to an arbitrary variable in this PHP process.
options.misconception: External stores cannot hold a live reference to an arbitrary variable in this PHP process.

options.text: The numeric field expires sooner than the object and is recomputed.
options.rationale: TTL applies to the entry; there is no per-property recomputation in this code.
options.misconception: TTL applies to the entry; there is no per-property recomputation in this code.

options.text: The unserialized array store retains the same object reference.
options.rationale: Mutating that object changes the in-process value held by this store; a serialized external store need not behave the same way.

options.text: Cache::put installs an Eloquent observer on every object.
options.rationale: This plain object has no Eloquent persistence observer, and the cache does not install one.
options.misconception: This plain object has no Eloquent persistence observer, and the cache does not install one.
